playbooks.title: Reopen the offline library
playbooks.trigger: The site loses its upstream internet connection.
steps: Connect to the school Wi-Fi and open the local library.
Search for the welcome article from a device with cellular data disabled.
Record the accepted edition in the operator log.

playbooks.title: Receive a new edition
playbooks.trigger: An approved publisher delivers a new library package.
steps: Confirm the publisher identity using the local trust record.
Apply the signed update and check that the reader opens the new edition.
Keep the last working archive until the handoff is complete.
